# Files where the fork only ever APPENDS lines to a struct/type/literal that
# upstream also appends to. git reports that as a conflict; the code does not
# care about the order, so these are merged with git's built-in "union" driver
# (keep both sides). verify.sh catches anything the union gets wrong.
